verdict.rationale: Airbyte supports several fixed event-to-action behaviors: notifications to email or webhook on important events, dbt Cloud transformations triggered immediately after syncs, and per-connection rules for handling source schema changes. These are predefined toggles, not a general user-defined rules engine. Missing for 10: arbitrary user-defined event→action rules or conditions, a broad catalog of trigger events and actions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
